fusions.name: First to Notice
fusions.desc: Sends a sharp click into the first enemy in its path for 4 resonating damage. It has 25% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Flushed From Cover
fusions.desc: Kicks out and deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking each back 3 tiles. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Startled Bolt
fusions.desc: Bolts you 4 tiles forward, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Flinch Before the Blow
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health forms for 3 seconds; once every 8 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
